ns2:course.label: Administration & Management of Libraries and Information Centers
ns2:course.description: Designed to explore the principles that govern how organizations and institutions work, this course provides a foundation for and introduction to the theories, practices and procedures involved in the management and administration of libraries and information centers. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Illinois Informatics Institute or Information Sciences department.
